kreesthuyesu khaideeyaina paulunu, sahodarudaina thimothiyunu maa priyudunu jathapanivaadunaina philemonukunu
mana sahodariyaina apphiyakunu, thoodi yodhudaina arkhippunakunu, nee yinta unna sanghamunakunu shubhamani cheppi vraayunadhi.
mana thandriyaina dhevuninundiyu prabhuvaina yesukreesthunundiyu krupayu samaadhaanamunu meeku kalugunu gaaka.
nee premanugoorchiyu, prabhuvaina yesu edalanu samastha parishuddhulayedalanu neeku kaligiyunna vishvaasamunu goorchiyu nenu vini
naa praarthanalayandu nee nimitthamu vignaapanamucheyuchu, ellappudu naa dhevuniki kruthagnathaa sthuthulu chellinchuchu,

kreesthunubatti meeyandunna prathi shreshthamaina varamu vishayamai neevu anubhavapoorvakamugaa erugutavalana itharulu nee vishvaasamandu paalivaaraguta anunadhi kaaryakaari kaavalayunani vedukonuchunnaanu.
sahodarudaa, parishuddhula hrudayamulu nee moolamugaa vishraanthi pondinanduna nee premanubatti naaku visheshamaina aanandamunu aadharanayu kaligenu.
kaavuna yukthamainadaaninigoorchi nee kaagnaapinchutaku kreesthunandu naaku bahu dhairyamu kaligiyunnanu,
vruddhudanu ippudu kreesthuyesu khaideenaiyunna paulanu nenu premanubatti vedukonuta mari manchidanukoni,
naa bandhakamulalo nenu kanina naa kumaarudagu onesimu kosaramu ninnu vedukonuchunnaanu.
athadu munupu neeku nish‌prayojanamainavaade gaani, yippudu neekunu naakunu prayojanakaramainavaadaayenu.
naa praanamu vantivaadaina athanini neeyoddhaku thirigi pampiyunnaanu.
nenu suvaarthakoraku bandhakamulo undagaa neeku prathigaa athadu naaku parichaaramucheyu nimitthamu naayoddha athani nunchukonavalenani yuntini gaani
nee upakaaramu balavanthamuchethanainattu kaaka svecchaapoorvakamainadhigaa undavalenani, nee sammathileka yemiyu cheyutaku naakishtamuledu.
athadikameedata daasudugaa undaka daasunikante ekkuvavaadugaanu, priya sahodarudu

gaanu, visheshamugaa naakunu, shareeravishayamunu prabhuvu vishayamunu mari visheshamugaa neekunu, priya saho darudugaanu, neeyoddha ellappudu undutake kaabolu athadu koddikaalamu ninnu edabaasi yundenu.
kaabatti neevu nannu neethoo paalivaanigaa enchinayedala nannu cherchu konnattu athanini cherchukonumu.
athadu neeku e nashtamainanu kalugajesina yedalanu, neeku emaina runamunna yedalanu, adhi naa lekkalo cherchumu;
paulanu nenu naa svahasthamuthoo ee maata vraayuchunnaanu adhi nene theerthunu. Ayinanu nee aatmavishayamulo neeve naaku runapadiyunnaavani nenu cheppanela?
avunu sahodarudaa, prabhuvunandu neevalana naaku aanandamu kaluganimmu, kreesthunandu naa hrudayamunaku vishraanthi kalugajeyumu.
nenu cheppinadaanikante neevu ekkuvagaa chethuvani yerigi naa maata vinduvani nammi neeku vraayuchunnaanu.
anthekaadu, nee praarthanala moolamugaa nenu neeku anugrahimpabadudunani nireekshinchuchunnaanu ganuka naa nimitthamu basa siddhamu cheyumu.
kreesthuyesunandu naathoodi khaideeyaina epaphraa,
naa jathapanivaaraina maarku, aristhaarku, dhemaa, lookaa vandhanamulu cheppuchunnaaru.
mana prabhuvaina yesukreesthu krupa mee aatmaku thoodai yundunu gaaka. Amen‌.
